import sys, struct

path = sys.argv[1]
with open(path, 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

print("file size:", len(data))
assert data[:4] == b'RIFF', data[:4]
riff_size = struct.unpack('<I', data[4:8])[0]
print("RIFF size field:", riff_size, " => total expected:", riff_size + 8)
assert data[8:12] == b'WAVE'

pos = 12
while pos + 8 <= len(data):
    cid = data[pos:pos+4]
    csize = struct.unpack('<I', data[pos+4:pos+8])[0]
    body_start = pos + 8
    body_end = body_start + csize
    print(f"chunk @{pos}: id={cid!r} size={csize} body=[{body_start},{body_end})")
    if cid != b'data':
        # dump small chunk bodies
        body = data[body_start:body_end]
        if len(body) <= 512:
            print("   hex:", body.hex())
            # printable
            printable = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 <= b < 127 else '.' for b in body)
            print("   asc:", printable)
        else:
            print("   (large, first 256 hex):", body[:256].hex())
    # advance, chunks are word-aligned (pad to even)
    advance = csize + (csize & 1)
    pos = body_start + advance

print("final pos:", pos, " file len:", len(data))
if pos < len(data):
    trailing = data[pos:]
    print("TRAILING BYTES:", len(trailing))
    print("   hex:", trailing[:512].hex())
    printable = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 <= b < 127 else '.' for b in trailing[:512])
    print("   asc:", printable)

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy import signal as sps

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
print("sr", sr, "shape", data.shape, "dtype", data.dtype)
print("duration", data.shape[0]/sr)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
R = data[:,1].astype(np.float64)
print("L range", L.min(), L.max(), "R range", R.min(), R.max())

# energy profile over time in 0.1s windows for the 25-34.4s region
def band_energy(x, sr, t0, t1, flo, fhi, nperseg=4096):
    i0=int(t0*sr); i1=int(t1*sr)
    seg = x[i0:i1]
    f, t, Sxx = sps.spectrogram(seg, sr, nperseg=nperseg, noverlap=nperseg*3//4)
    mask = (f>=flo)&(f<=fhi)
    e = Sxx[mask,:].sum(axis=0)
    return t+t0, e

# overall RMS per 0.1s
win=int(0.1*sr)
n=len(L)//win
rms=[]
for i in range(n):
    seg=L[i*win:(i+1)*win]
    rms.append(np.sqrt((seg**2).mean()))
rms=np.array(rms)
for i in range(n):
    t=i*0.1
    print(f"t={t:5.1f}  Lrms={rms[i]:8.1f}")

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy import signal as sps
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
R = data[:,1].astype(np.float64)

def plot_spec(x, sr, t0, t1, fmin, fmax, fname, nperseg=2048, noverlap_frac=0.9, title=""):
    i0=int(t0*sr); i1=int(t1*sr)
    seg=x[i0:i1]
    nov=int(nperseg*noverlap_frac)
    f,t,Sxx=sps.spectrogram(seg,sr,window='hann',nperseg=nperseg,noverlap=nov,scaling='spectrum',mode='magnitude')
    mask=(f>=fmin)&(f<=fmax)
    S=Sxx[mask,:]
    ff=f[mask]
    Sdb=20*np.log10(S+1e-6)
    plt.figure(figsize=(18,8))
    plt.pcolormesh(t+t0, ff, Sdb, shading='nearest', cmap='magma')
    plt.colorbar(label='dB')
    plt.ylabel('Hz'); plt.xlabel('s'); plt.title(title or fname)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(fname, dpi=110)
    plt.close()
    print("wrote", fname, "f-res", f[1]-f[0], "t-bins", len(t))

# frag3 known region 22.68-24.15s, tones 880..3520
plot_spec(L, sr, 22.5, 24.3, 400, 4200, '/home/vboxuser/misc-work/frag3_L.png', nperseg=2048, title='frag3 L 22.5-24.3 400-4200Hz')
# the 25-34.4 mystery region, wide band
plot_spec(L, sr, 24.9, 34.4, 3000, 18000, '/home/vboxuser/misc-work/myst_L_wide.png', nperseg=2048, title='myst L 24.9-34.4 3-18kHz')
plot_spec(R, sr, 24.9, 34.4, 3000, 18000, '/home/vboxuser/misc-work/myst_R_wide.png', nperseg=2048, title='myst R 24.9-34.4 3-18kHz')

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy import signal as sps

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
R = data[:,1].astype(np.float64)

# focus on 25.0 - 34.4
t0, t1 = 25.0, 34.4
i0, i1 = int(t0*sr), int(t1*sr)
seg = L[i0:i1]

# high-pass > 3500 to isolate the layer
sos = sps.butter(6, 3500, 'hp', fs=sr, output='sos')
hp = sps.sosfilt(sos, seg)

# energy envelope
env = np.abs(sps.hilbert(hp))
# smooth
win = int(0.02*sr)
k = np.ones(win)/win
smooth = np.convolve(env, k, mode='same')

thr = smooth.max()*0.08
active = smooth > thr
# find contiguous runs
runs=[]
i=0
N=len(active)
while i<N:
    if active[i]:
        j=i
        while j<N and active[j]:
            j+=1
        runs.append((i,j))
        i=j
    else:
        i+=1
# merge runs separated by < 0.05s, drop short < 0.03s
merged=[]
for r in runs:
    if merged and (r[0]-merged[-1][1]) < int(0.06*sr):
        merged[-1]=(merged[-1][0], r[1])
    else:
        merged.append(list(r))
bursts=[r for r in merged if (r[1]-r[0]) > int(0.05*sr)]

print(f"found {len(bursts)} bursts")
for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(bursts):
    ta=t0+a/sr; tb=t0+b/sr
    x=hp[a:b]
    # window
    w=np.hanning(len(x))
    X=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x*w))
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),1/sr)
    # top 6 peaks
    peak_idx=np.argsort(X)[::-1]
    seen=[]
    for pi in peak_idx:
        fr=freqs[pi]
        if all(abs(fr-s)>150 for s in seen):
            seen.append(fr)
        if len(seen)>=6: break
    seen_sorted=sorted(seen)
    print(f"burst {bi}: t=[{ta:.3f},{tb:.3f}] dur={tb-ta:.3f}s  peaks(Hz): "+
          ", ".join(f"{s:.0f}" for s in seen_sorted))

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy import signal as sps

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
R = data[:,1].astype(np.float64)

# burst windows (start,end) seconds - from detection, tightened to core
bursts = [(25.174,25.366),(26.207,26.348),(26.433,26.496),(26.863,27.021),
          (27.864,28.088),(29.322,29.663),(30.699,31.006),(32.328,32.464)]

def analyze(x, ta, tb):
    i0,i1=int(ta*sr),int(tb*sr)
    seg=x[i0:i1].astype(np.float64)
    seg=seg-seg.mean()
    w=np.hanning(len(seg))
    sw=seg*w
    # power spectrum
    nfft=1<<18
    X=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(sw,nfft))
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(nfft,1/sr)
    # restrict to 3000-20000
    band=(freqs>=3000)&(freqs<=20000)
    Xb=X.copy(); Xb[~band]=0
    # spectral centroid in band
    centroid=(freqs[band]*X[band]).sum()/X[band].sum()
    # dominant peak
    pk=freqs[np.argmax(Xb)]
    # harmonic spacing via autocorrelation of band-limited spectrum magnitude
    spec=X[band]
    spec=spec-spec.mean()
    ac=np.correlate(spec,spec,mode='full')[len(spec)-1:]
    df=freqs[1]-freqs[0]
    # look for first strong peak in AC beyond a minimum spacing (fundamental ~ > 2000 Hz? no)
    # harmonic spacing candidate: search 3000-9000 Hz
    lo=int(3000/df); hi=int(9000/df)
    seg_ac=ac[lo:hi]
    hs=(lo+np.argmax(seg_ac))*df
    return pk, centroid, hs

print("burst |  peakHz | centroidHz | harmSpacingHz | peak/100 | cent/100")
for k,(ta,tb) in enumerate(bursts):
    pk,cent,hs=analyze(L,ta,tb)
    print(f"  {k}   | {pk:8.1f} | {cent:9.1f} | {hs:10.1f} | {pk/100:6.2f} | {cent/100:6.2f}")

print("id3 body hex:", id3.hex())
print("id3 ascii:", ''.join(chr(b) if 32<=b<127 else '.' for b in id3))
print()

pat=re.compile(rb'[A-Za-z0-9+/]{8,}={0,2}')

    tok=m.group()
    # skip if inside the big audio region unless it has = padding (reduce noise): still print those with '=' anywhere
    s=tok.decode('latin1')
    if s in seen:
        continue
    # decode attempt
    try:
        dec=base64.b64decode(tok+b'='*((4-len(tok)%4)%4), validate=False)
        printable=all(32<=c<127 for c in dec) and len(dec)>0
    except Exception:
        dec=b''; printable=False
    # only report tokens that either have padding '=' OR decode to fully-printable ascii and are not in pure-audio noise
    if (b'=' in tok) or (printable and len(tok)<=40):
        off=m.start()
        # focus: report tokens near metadata OR that decode to printable leet-ish
        if printable or b'=' in tok:
            if off > 6000000 or printable:
                seen.add(s)
                dd = dec if printable else b''
                print(f"off={off} tok={s!r} -> decoded={dd!r} printable={printable}")

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy import signal as sps

path=sys.argv[1]
sr,data=wavfile.read(path)
L=data[:,0].astype(np.float64)

# precise burst cores
bursts=[(25.18,25.34),(26.21,26.33),(26.95,27.03),(27.87,28.05),(29.36,29.60),(30.70,30.95),(32.30,32.50)]
# note: merged some; let's also include the 26.4 mid bump separately? Use clean set.

def tones(ta,tb):
    i0,i1=int(ta*sr),int(tb*sr)
    seg=L[i0:i1].astype(np.float64); seg-=seg.mean()
    w=np.hanning(len(seg)); sw=seg*w
    nfft=1<<17
    X=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(sw,nfft)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(nfft,1/sr)
    band=(fr>=3500)&(fr<=17000)
    Xb=np.where(band,X,0)
    pk,props=sps.find_peaks(Xb,height=Xb.max()*0.3,distance=int(300/(fr[1]-fr[0])))
    pk=pk[np.argsort(Xb[pk])[::-1]]
    freqs=[fr[p] for p in pk[:5]]
    return sorted(freqs)

for k,(ta,tb) in enumerate(bursts):
    fs=tones(ta,tb)
    print(f"burst {k} [{ta}-{tb}]: peaks = "+", ".join(f"{x:.0f}" for x in fs))

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy import signal as sps
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

path=sys.argv[1]
sr,data=wavfile.read(path)
L=data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
t0,t1=25.0,33.0
seg=L[int(t0*sr):int(t1*sr)]
# high-pass >3500 to isolate layer
sos=sps.butter(8,3500,'hp',fs=sr,output='sos')
hp=sps.sosfilt(sos,seg)
# analytic signal
an=sps.hilbert(hp)
tt=np.arange(len(hp))/sr

carriers=[3800,4200,4600,5000]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(len(carriers),1,figsize=(22,16))
for ci,fc in enumerate(carriers):
    # shift down by fc: multiply analytic by exp(-j 2pi fc t), take real
    bb=np.real(an*np.exp(-1j*2*np.pi*fc*tt))
    # lowpass 4000
    sos2=sps.butter(8,4000,'lp',fs=sr,output='sos')
    bbl=sps.sosfilt(sos2,bb)
    f,t,Sxx=sps.spectrogram(bbl,sr,window='hann',nperseg=2048,noverlap=1536,scaling='spectrum',mode='magnitude')
    mask=f<=4500
    Sdb=20*np.log10(Sxx[mask]+1e-6)
    ax=axes[ci]
    ax.pcolormesh(t+t0,f[mask],Sdb,shading='nearest',cmap='magma')
    ax.set_title(f'demod carrier {fc}Hz -> baseband 0-4.5kHz')
    ax.set_ylabel('Hz')
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('/home/vboxuser/misc-work/demod.png',dpi=80);plt.close()
print("wrote demod.png")

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy import signal as sps

path=sys.argv[1]
sr,data=wavfile.read(path)
L=data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
R=data[:,1].astype(np.float64)

# per-burst stereo stats
bursts=[(25.18,25.34),(26.21,26.33),(26.95,27.03),(27.87,28.05),(29.36,29.60),(30.70,30.95),(32.30,32.50)]
# high-pass both
sos=sps.butter(8,3500,'hp',fs=sr,output='sos')
Lh=sps.sosfilt(sos,L); Rh=sps.sosfilt(sos,R)

print("burst | rmsL | rmsR | L/R | corr | rms(L-R) | rms(L+R)")
for k,(ta,tb) in enumerate(bursts):
    i0,i1=int(ta*sr),int(tb*sr)
    l=Lh[i0:i1]; r=Rh[i0:i1]
    rl=np.sqrt((l**2).mean()); rr=np.sqrt((r**2).mean())
    corr=np.corrcoef(l,r)[0,1]
    rd=np.sqrt(((l-r)**2).mean()); rs=np.sqrt(((l+r)**2).mean())
    print(f"  {k}  |{rl:7.1f}|{rr:7.1f}|{rl/rr:5.2f}|{corr:6.3f}|{rd:8.1f}|{rs:8.1f}")

# also whole-region correlation
i0,i1=int(25.0*sr),int(33.0*sr)
l=Lh[i0:i1]; r=Rh[i0:i1]
print("whole 25-33 corr(L,R)=",np.corrcoef(l,r)[0,1])
print("whole 25-33 rms(L-R)=",np.sqrt(((l-r)**2).mean()), " rmsL=",np.sqrt((l**2).mean()))
# cross-correlation lag between L and R per burst (phase)
for k,(ta,tb) in enumerate(bursts):
    i0,i1=int(ta*sr),int(tb*sr)
    l=Lh[i0:i1]-Lh[i0:i1].mean(); r=Rh[i0:i1]-Rh[i0:i1].mean()
    xc=sps.correlate(l,r,mode='full')
    lag=np.argmax(xc)-(len(l)-1)
    print(f"burst {k} best lag L vs R = {lag} samples ({lag/sr*1e6:.1f} us)")
